title: Sentence Structure: Avoid Fragments and Run-ons
objective: Students build complete academic sentences and combine ideas clearly.
context: Student draft: “Because the pond was dry. We saw no frogs we wrote a note.”

items.prompt: Find the incomplete part. Why is it incomplete?
items.answer: Because the pond was dry. It gives a reason but needs a main clause.

items.prompt: Separate the two complete ideas after the full stop.
items.answer: We saw no frogs. We wrote a note.
items.hint: Find both subjects and their verbs.

items.prompt: Repair the whole draft. Keep the original ideas.
items.answer: Because the pond was dry, we saw no frogs. We wrote a note.
items.hint: Join the reason to a complete idea.
